enableJournalDevice is set: every worker hands over one disk smaller than its others, the smallest being 3T (0000:5e:00.0) on worker-01, and the control plane dedicates that disk to the journal manager instead of carving a journal partition out of every disk. This is the line to remove if the disk was meant to carry data
stripe is 1+0 as a single-node cluster (clusterMode Single), which protects nothing: the worker hands over 1 device for data, and a redundant scheme places each chunk of a stripe on its own device, so 1+1 needs two. A cluster's stripe cannot be changed afterward
wrote discovered-discover-dev-08 in Draft: 1 workers with 2 nvme devices, in 1 group(s) across 1 node set(s); 0 refusal(s)
